package probe

import "os/exec"

// The exemption admits "go" whatever follows it, and the subcommand is still
// no literal, so the call is refused: a sub a literal-only exemption cannot
// read is never exempt.
func nameOnlyExemptionCommand(sub string) error {
	cmd := exec.Command("go", sub, "./cmd/x")
	return cmd.Run()
}
